name: Groove Quantum
description: Groove Quantum builds scalable quantum processors based on germanium spin qubits, using fabrication processes compatible with standard semiconductor manufacturing. The company was spun out of QuTech (TU Delft / TNO) and received a €10M EIC Accelerator grant and equity investment in 2025.
funding: €16M total (seed co-led by Innovation Industries and 55 North + EIC Accelerator grant, 2026)

news.title: Groove Quantum Raises €16M and Demonstrates 18-Qubit Germanium Spin-Qubit Processor
news.excerpt: Dutch quantum startup Groove Quantum secured €16 million in combined equity and grants in a seed round co-led by Innovation Industries and 55 North, and simultaneously demonstrated an 18-qubit germanium semiconductor spin-qubit processor, claiming the largest of its kind. The company plans to scale toward a 100-qubit tiled unit cell.
